Starting from Android 10, capturing internal audio requires the MediaProjection API, which always requires the RECORD_AUDIO permission, even if you only intend to capture system audio and not the microphone. This is a precautionary measure enforced by the OS: the audio pipeline is initialized as a single unit, and the system requests the permission upfront without knowing in advance which source will be used. Additionally, some OEM implementations (Samsung, Xiaomi, and others) enforce this requirement more strictly than stock Android, making the permission effectively mandatory in all cases.

Generate URIs and intents to trigger actions from NFC tags, Tasker, MacroDroid or shortcuts
Generate a URI to write to an NFC tag or open from any automation app. Empty fields keep the app defaults. Saved scripts can be run, copied or shared.

NFC tags, Tasker, MacroDroid and ADB reach this app through a public entry point, so any installed app could send a command too. External commands stay refused until you turn them on here. Once on, only commands carrying the token below run: the URIs and commands generated on this screen already include it.
Anyone holding the token can drive the app. Regenerating it invalidates every URI, NFC tag and automation already set up.
